text.description_html:
Deltana DEL-DSF-RUBBER Rubber Tip Replacement

This is a replacement rubber tip for Deltana Heavy Duty Door Stops/Bumpers.

For use with:
Deltana DSF3225 Floor Mount Door Bumper
Deltana DSF444 Floor Mount Door Bumper
Deltana SAHF358 Floor Mount Door Bumper
Deltana DSF630 6" Floor Mount Door Bumper
Deltana DSF600 6" Floor Mount Door Bumper
Deltana DSF830 8" Floor Mount Door Bumper
Deltana DSF800 8" Floor Mount Door Bumper
Deltana SAHW325 Wall Mount Door Bumper
Deltana DSW325 Floor Mount Door Bumper

Easy to replace - Just pull the old rubber tip out of the door stop and slide the replacement rubber tip in.

Note: The door stop does NOT have to be removed to replace the rubber bumper tip.

Specifications: for Deltana DSF-RUBBER Rubber Tip Replacement

  • Diameter: 1", Black Rubber
  • Total Length: 1-1/2"

Warning: These work on Heavy Duty Door Stops manufactured by Deltana. If you are not sure if your door bumper was manufactured by Deltana, do NOT order these as they may not work properly.

*Sold individually - NO RETURNS
